long_biography.plain_text:
Hartnoll joined X-Press Feeders in 1981, working under his father, Chris, as containerisation reshaped Asian trade. A major customer later withdrew outsourced services, forcing the company to rebuild. Hartnoll became managing director in 1992 and extended the feeder network from Asia into Europe, the Mediterranean and the Americas.

Chairmanship shifted his attention toward maritime investment and environmental projects. X-Press began ordering methanol-capable ships and funding research into fuel cells and energy storage. Hartnoll also developed Bawah Reserve around conservation principles and supported scientific research and scholarships at the University of Warwick.
